articles.headline: Martin Shkreli Says Micron Is Closing In on Nvidia's Profits: 'I Like Micron Right Now'
articles.summary: Former hedge fund manager Martin Shkreli says Micron (MU) is closing the profit gap with Nvidia (NVDA), brushing off the latest memory selloff.
articles._summary: “You guys are staring at the abyss 30 minutes ago thinking like, how do I explain this to my wifey?” he said on a livestream as the market recovered. “We going to Red Lobster again? Again?” The panic obscured what he sees as the real story. “I think they’re going to do more net income than Nvidia just even next quarter,” Shkreli said, before pulling up the figures. Micron reportedly earned $28 billion last quarter against Nvidia’s $58 billion, with the gap projected to narrow to $35 billion versus $51 billion.

articles.headline: QUICK SPARK: Energy Overtakes Technology As 2026's Best Sector
articles.summary: Energy has overtaken tech as 2026's best sector, up 29% as the Iran war lifts oil. XLE jumped 9% in July while XLK fell 6.8% on the chip rout.
articles._summary: Energy has quietly taken the crown after the collapse of the June U.S.-Iran ceasefire and a fresh wave of strikes across the Middle East. The Energy Select Sector SPDR Fund (NYSE: XLE ) has risen 29.4% in 2026, overtaking technology — up 23% — as the stock market’s best-performing sector. Renewed fighting between the U.S. and Iran has pushed Brent crude back near $85 a barrel, with the Strait of Hormuz — the chokepoint that carries roughly a fifth of the world’s seaborne oil — still blocked.

articles._zh_summary: 在六月美伊停火破裂以及中东新一轮袭击浪潮之后，能源悄然占据了王位。能源精选行业 SPDR 基金（纽约证券交易所股票代码：XLE）在 2026 年上涨了 29.4%，超过上涨 23% 的科技股，成为股市表现最佳的行业。美国和伊朗之间的新一轮战斗已将布伦特原油价格推至每桶 85 美元附近，而霍尔木兹海峡——输送全球约五分之一海运石油的咽喉要道——仍然被封锁。
